description: Closed-set conformance fixtures for the W1 soc.get_alert_context invocation transport-binding profile, which is PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED. Positive fixtures must validate against the binding schema, negative-schema fixtures must be rejected structurally, and negative-semantic fixtures must stay structurally valid while witnessing a runtime trust obligation that no schema can decide. The standalone validator independently pins every filename and kind, rejects missing, orphan, symlinked and duplicate fixtures, recomputes every inline bound-output digest and every reused C1 available-result context digest under constrained RFC 8785/JCS, reconstructs the accepted C1 business request from the bound request and compares it byte-for-byte with the accepted C1 request fixture, and verifies every manifest member hash. Each negative row cites a canonical trust-invariant label that the compatibility manifest owns, so a fixture cannot be relabelled into an untraceable claim. This is static evidence only: it demonstrates no endpoint, no transport or MCP surface, no capability-registry entry, no Fabric invocation grant, no W2-F delegation authority, no policy completion, no kill-switch behavior, no CI wiring and no runtime enforcement, and it records no acceptance.

examples.invariant: TB-3 The caller may never assert the credential- and policy-derived authorization binding; the closed caller-argument channel rejects an authorization_binding the caller supplied for itself.
TB-2 The capability pin is exact soc.get_alert_context@0.1.0 over an opaque registry-owned descriptor digest; a drifting version is rejected structurally before any correlation check runs.
TB-4 approval_required and approval_id are outside this synchronous non-approval-gated R0 read profile; the restricted envelope status set rejects them.
TB-8 The business result travels inline inside output.data only; an artifact-locator side channel is rejected so the digest-bound payload has exactly one wire home.

TB-6 Envelope status=unavailable is transport-level unavailability and must carry no business payload; the C1 business outcome=unavailable is a different meaning that travels inside envelope status=completed.
TB-7 A completed bound result must carry receipt_id; a completed invocation that returns a business payload without a receipt reference is rejected.
TR-1 The idempotency key must be identical in all four bound positions; this structurally valid fixture rebinds the envelope key away from the bound business key and must fail closed at runtime.
TR-2 The envelope actor tenant must equal the credential-derived authoritative envelope tenant; this structurally valid cross-tenant fixture must fail closed at runtime.

TR-3 A W2-F internal service delegation token is never a Fabric tool grant; this structurally valid fixture presents the constrained-JCS digest of the accepted W2-F token as delegation_ref and must fail closed at runtime.
